items.stem: An AI assistant returns a clear tax answer citing a specific code section that looks plausible. What must the associate do before relying on it?

options.text: Verify the cited section and its current wording against an authoritative source
options.rationale: Correct: AI can cite plausible but wrong or outdated authority, so citations must be checked.

options.text: File the position immediately because the citation looks real
options.rationale: A plausible-looking citation can be fabricated or outdated; it must be verified.

options.text: Assume the answer is correct if it is confidently worded
options.rationale: Confidence of tone is not evidence of accuracy.

options.text: Delete the research memo to avoid liability
options.rationale: The memo is useful once verified; the fix is verification, not deletion.

items.explanation: Correct: AI can cite plausible but wrong or outdated authority, so citations must be checked.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO practices protect client confidentiality when using an AI tool for tax work? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Confirm the tool's data handling meets firm policy before entering client data
options.rationale: Correct: data governance must be checked before confidential data is used.

options.text: Minimise or anonymise client identifiers where the task allows
options.rationale: Correct: limiting identifiable data reduces confidentiality risk.

options.text: Paste full client records into any free public chatbot
options.rationale: Uncontrolled tools can expose confidential data and breach policy.

options.text: Assume all AI tools are confidential by default
options.rationale: Confidentiality must be verified, not assumed.

items.explanation: Correct: data governance must be checked before confidential data is used.

items.stem: A client asks 'How is this income taxed?' and the associate prompts the AI with exactly that wording. Why is the prompt likely to produce a weak answer?

options.text: It omits jurisdiction, tax year and key facts the answer depends on
options.rationale: Correct: tax treatment depends on jurisdiction, year and facts the prompt must supply.

options.text: AI cannot answer any tax question at all
options.rationale: AI can assist when the prompt is well framed; the issue is the missing context.

options.text: The prompt is too long and detailed
options.rationale: The prompt is too sparse, not too detailed.

options.text: Tax questions should never be researched with AI
options.rationale: AI can support research; the prompt simply needs the right context.

items.explanation: Correct: tax treatment depends on jurisdiction, year and facts the prompt must supply.
